goal: Generate a teaching page to help learners with a foundational understanding of linear algebra intuitively grasp single-head self-attention, focusing on building mental models without deriving formulas.

style.rendering: Flat infographic + extremely fine isometric grid faintly printed, not stealing focus from the main image.

header.main_title: 自注意力在干什么：为每个词向整句「重新取权重」
header.subtitle: Query, Key, Value Three-Step Intuitive Version
header.audience: Undergraduate students and engineer introductory training.

centerpiece.description: In the center of the image, there are five horizontal word position boxes, each leading three short arrows to three small color blocks at the same level, labeled Q, K, V. Above it, there's a small heatmap with five words in rows and columns, displaying attention weights. Below the heatmap, it says softmax, and an arrow on the right points to a column of new vectors, representing the output position after the weighted sum.

steps.count: Vivid magenta background steals the scene.
items: 01 Generate Query, Key, and Value Vectors for Each Word Position (Linear Projection, Parameters Shared Across the Layer)
02 Use the Current Word's Query to Score Similarity with All Words' Keys, Obtaining a Column of Scores
03 Scale Scores and Apply Softmax to Obtain Attention Weights, Weight Size Indicates 'Where to Look'
04 Weighting all word value vectors to obtain a new representation of the word
05 Five word positions can be executed in parallel using a matrix at once (classroom does not need to expand matrix size)
06 Multi-head is parallel with multiple sets of QKV projections, then stitched back to express different relational subspaces
steps.step_block_style: Number + short sentence, with a minimalist geometric icon, without using real code screenshots

annotations.style: 自方框向热力图、再向输出去向的细曲线箭头，统一灰蓝
annotations.rule: Heat map does not simulate real pre-trained weights, only for illustration; leads are not haphazard

summary_line: Intuition: Self-attention = 'Allocate attention to each relevant position in the whole sentence based on the current question and consolidate information'; the number of heads is just multiple sets running in parallel.

must_keep: Six steps consistent with the central diagram, order fixed
No introducing RNN state propagation to avoid interference with the theme
Terminology in Chinese and English can be listed once within parentheses
avoid: Include BERT and Diffusion Models in One Image
